answer_prose: More recorded experience was not simply associated with less slowing: median second-20-km slowdown was 8.8% after one earlier finish and 11.7% after five or more. Age, course choice and who keeps racing can affect this comparison.
detail_prose: Experience here means appearances in this dataset. The first observed race is not necessarily a marathon debut.
